text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers (13.5%, 3.3%, 5.22, z 1.41, 43%, 45 claims, 19 documented 99215, 4 of 30) match the card, and the tone is cautious with sensible next steps (pull notes, request audit trail). But several claims are wrong or ungrounded, and the headline contradicts the data, so an investigator would have to redo some checks.","problems":["Headline says 99215 is 'well above expectation in every complexity band', but the card gives only by_complexity shares versus the all-provider share; the 0-2 condition bands are ~0.09-0.10 versus 0.026-0.057, which is elevated but not an expectation comparison. Roughly supportable but overstated.","Claims C0003110 and C0003291/C0003292 are cited as 'simple presentations'. C0003110 is J06.9 (URI) and fits. C0003291/C0003292 have Z09 (follow-up exam) and age 24 and 21, so 'follow-up visits' is fine. However, C0003224 is listed as 'sampled 99215s include' URI and is also called supported by high MDM; this is consistent. Still, C0003110 has no documentation, so it is not evidence of a documented simple presentation.","Comparison rate '17%' for comparison providers is on the card (0.174) and matches, but the provider's documented-below-billed rate of 5% is based on only 19 charts, and the summary does not flag the small sample.","'Problem-list note signal 33%' is described as 'frequent' but the packet does not define what the problems sign means or give a comparison rate; the 'late 2%, unsigned 0%, data 7%' note-check numbers are not on the card and rely on tool output not shown here.","Unmatched number 7 (from 'data 7%') could not be verified against the card.","Cited C0003346 is below-billed (moderate MDM) yet the rationale argues the charts support billed levels; this is the one downcoded example and is not explained.","'No audit trail was received' is presumably from the exchange output, but it is not verifiable here.","The rationale is long and somewhat repetitive; the leaning 'inconclusive' is defensible but the headline mixes strong and weak signals."]}
